Rule: Always use local image files (artefacts/) instead of hotlinked URLs
Description: Download images to a local subfolder and reference them with relative paths. Hotlinked URLs can break if the source deletes or moves them.
Context: When user asked to populate the audit file with pictures from the multi-page site

Rule: Pair every text element with lang="it" and lang="en" spans
Description: Use <span lang=""it""> and <span lang=""en""> inside every text container. Toggle with data-lang=""en"" on <body>.
Context: Required for bilingual IT/EN toggle functionality

Rule: Save bg images in a local artefacts/ folder
Description: Store all generated/uploaded images in a dedicated artefacts/ subfolder within the project directory.
Context: User requested all PNGs saved in one subfolder

Rule: Use section ID anchors for nav menu (not external links)
Description: Nav items should link to #section-id within the same page rather than separate .html files.
Context: User rejected external nav links in favour of same-page section jumps

Rule: Keep section 06 (methodology) out of the nav menu
Description: Routine documentation sections go in the footer/basement — not in the primary nav.
Context: User explicitly: 'leave it there just in the basement'

Rule: Use CSS custom properties for theming
Description: Centralise colours/shadows/sizes in :root variables. Makes dark mode and future theming trivial.
Context: Standard practice reinforced by dark/light toggle

Rule: Store theme and language preferences in localStorage
Description: Persist dark/light and lang choice so the user's preference survives page reloads.
Context: Cookie consent and theme toggle require persistence

Rule: Use IntersectionObserver for scroll animations
Description: Vanilla JS observer is lighter and more performant than jQuery or external libraries.
Context: Scroll reveal animations across all sections

Rule: Wrap tables in .table-wrap for overflow-x
Description: Prevent horizontal scroll breakage on mobile by wrapping <table> in a scrollable div.
Context: Table in sections 01 and 03 would overflow on narrow screens

Rule: Place WhatsApp FAB fixed bottom-right with proper href
Description: Use href="https://wa.me/..." with pre-filled message. Green #1fb855 for brand consistency.
Context: Clickable WhatsApp button requested

Rule: Implement cookie consent with Accept/Reject + granular modal
Description: Show banner on first visit, store consent in localStorage, provide settings modal with toggle switches.
Context: Modern site requirement for GDPR/privacy compliance

Rule: Embed Google Maps via responsive iframe with lazy loading
Description: Use <iframe loading="lazy"> inside a .map-wrap container with border-radius and shadow.
Context: Map section for AVIBE Agency address

Rule: Use dropdown (accordion) for supplementary data sections
Description: Long tables or secondary analysis belong in expandable dropdowns to keep the page scannable.
Context: Anomalie sitemap and KPI baseline sections

Rule: Use numbered steps (counter-increment) for action plans
Description: CSS counter with decimal-leading-zero creates a clean roadmap visual for sequential items.
Context: Section 05 — Piano di Intervento Prioritario

Rule: Animate images with CSS clip-path reveal + glow hover
Description: .img-reveal uses opacity + clip-path transition on scroll; .img-glow adds brightness on hover.
Context: Gallery section scroll animations

Rule: Remove 'creare' from GBP action — only 'rivendicare'
Description: Don't suggest creating a profile when the user already has one — only claim/rivendicare the existing one.
Context: User correction on step 1 copy

Rule: Don't use 'foto reali' — use 'foto attraente' instead
Description: Avoid generic 'real photos'; use aspirational 'attractive photos' for business profile imagery.
Context: User correction on step 1 copy

Rule: Don't link nav to external pages (index.html etc)
Description: The audit page is a standalone document. Nav should scroll to internal sections only.
Context: User: 'build the menu by the names of the sections'

Rule: Don't put section 06 in the main nav
Description: Methodological notes belong in the footer/basement — not in the navigation.
Context: User: 'leave it there just in the basement'

Rule: Don't use serif fonts for UI elements
Description: Use Helvetica Neue / sans-serif for nav
Context: buttons
column8: labels. Reserve serif for body text and headings.
column9: Standard practice across both audit and multi-page site

Rule: Don't use jQuery or heavy libraries
Description: Vanilla JS is sufficient for all features: IntersectionObserver
Context: localStorage

Rule: Don't hardcode light-only colours
Description: Every colour declaration must have a [data-theme="dark"] override, or use CSS custom properties that switch.
Context: Required for functioning dark/light toggle

Rule: Don't use file:// paths in browser images
Description: Use relative paths (artefacts/filename.png) not absolute file:/// paths — browser blocks file:// for security.
Context: Image loading from artefacts folder

Rule: Don't mix inline and external styles
Description: Keep all CSS in one <style> block in the <head>. Scattered inline styles make theming harder.
Context: Dark mode requires centralised control of colours
